evidence.title: Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis: Ranking Candidate Drivers by Convergent Cross-Method Evidence from Observational Data

summary: Researchers propose a new framework, Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis, to rank potential causal factors by combining convergent evidence from multiple observational methods. The approach aims to improve causal inference in complex systems where experimental data is limited.
title: Study Introduces Multi-Method Approach to Rank Causal Drivers Using Observational Data
